recipe.visualDefinition: A medium portrait of a male figure leaning against a weathered, industrial red and grey corrugated metal wall, positioned next to a vintage motorcycle. The image features heavy distressing, high-contrast lighting, and bold, textured typography centered over the subject's torso.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject integrated with industrial environment through shared texture and lighting
Bold white typography contrasting against dark clothing and red background
Diagonal lines of the corrugated metal leading the eye toward the subject's face
Motorcycle handlebars framing the left side of the composition
coreInvariants: Heavy grit and scratch texture overlay across the entire frame
Desaturated skin tones with high-contrast shadows
Industrial, weathered setting with peeling paint effects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, subject seated and leaning back, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large, distressed white display text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down to the large display text, then follows the motorcycle handlebars to the left edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with textures and industrial details.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and desaturated denim blues in the subject's clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Oxidized red and cool grey in the corrugated metal background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for the primary typography to ensure legibility against the busy background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high tonal contrast; shadows are deep and highlights are blown out in the textures.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to earthy, industrial tones

letterConstructionRules: Squarish proportions with slight rounding on corners
Tight kerning for a compact, block-like appearance
characterSpecificRedesigns: Heavy distressing and 'eroded' texture applied to the fill of all characters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, distressed display font paired with a smaller, clean sans-serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Vertical text orientation for secondary artist name
Texture overlays that unify text and image

preserve: Heavy distressing on the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed profile for the display text.
Classic Americana feel with the right proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium portrait of a man with shaggy hair wearing a dark t-shirt, leaning against a weathered red and grey corrugated metal wall. Include a vintage motorcycle handlebar in the lower left. Apply a heavy grit, scratch, and film-grain texture over the entire scene.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, condensed, bold sans-serif text in white across the center. Apply a heavy 'eroded' or 'stamped' texture to the text so it looks weathered. Add a smaller, clean sans-serif subtitle directly below it.

verificationChecks: Is the main text heavily distressed?
Is the background industrial and weathered?
Is the color palette dominated by red, grey, and charcoal?
Does the text overlap the subject's torso?

adjustableVariables: Ratio of red to grey in the background
Level of distressing on the typography
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text texture matches the background grit
Ensure the subject's eyes are a focal point despite the text
Verify the vertical text alignment on the right side
Confirm the diagonal lines of the wall are preserved
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Portrait + Weathered Corrugated Metal + Distressed Condensed Sans-Serif + High Contrast Grit Overlay
